title: Pfizer defends its high dividend yield and assures it is sustainable
summary: The pharmaceutical company explains that its cash flow is solid and that the dividend payment is not at risk.

title: Social Security COLA for 2027 will rise 4.7%, the largest increase in years
summary: Social Security beneficiaries in the U.S. will receive a historic 4.7% increase in their benefits in 2027, although experts warn that the increase is driven by inflation.

title: China fines Trip.com $700 million for abuse of dominant position in online travel
summary: Chinese antitrust authorities sanctioned the travel agency for forcing hotels to offer exclusive minimum prices on its platform.

title: Kuwait signs lease agreement for its pipeline network worth $16 billion with Blackstone, KKR and Brookfield
summary: State-owned oil company KPC transfers operation of its pipeline infrastructure under a long-term lease contract valued at $16 billion.

title: South Korea and U.S. announce AI cooperation agreements worth more than $950 billion
summary: During a summit in Seoul, Samsung, SK Group and Nvidia sealed massive investments in chips and artificial intelligence data centers.

title: Ibex closes the week at 19,600 points with a 1.9% advance amid tariffs and corporate earnings
summary: The Spanish selective index added its fifth consecutive weekly gain, driven by stocks like Acerinox and the overcoming of technical resistances.
